name: export-norway-company-registry-data-for-crm
title: Export Norway Company Registry Data for CRM
description: Read Norwegian company records from BRREG Enhetsregisteret. Replace the sample organization numbers with your own nine-digit IDs and keep one monitorKey per list. Each run returns current company records for CRM import, with VAT and bankruptcy flags and explicit statuses for unverified checks.
